item.title: Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii
item.description: Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.
item.content:encoded:
Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.

item.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
item.description: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.

item.title: Trump wants to remove a question about race in the census. We look back at the history
item.description: The Trump administration wants to stop asking about race and ethnicity on the next U.S. census. Since 1790, the topic has been used to exclude people of color, and, more recently, for inclusion.

item.title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table
item.description: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.

item.title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
item.description: The Ohio governor's race pits former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton, a former state health advisor. Democrats see a chance to win a state that usually votes Republican.

item.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
item.description: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.
